findings.result: Actual journal binding calls the production session reset before binding new state. Focused sanitizer probe reuses the character state address and switches back and forth: active companion identity, own EXP/vitals/settings remain distinct; temporary commands/shots/emotes/access cache/staging and CPU/GPU actor resources clear.

Road/script gates check admission before world activation; native managed menu choice preflight runs before VM answer; utility travel checks destination before SP/gem consumption; entering an existing portal checks before decrementing uses. Courier fare follows successful warp. Review found no new fee/state-loss defect.

Own growth is read from per-character records; missing recruits are seeded once, formation binding reloads config, promotions require authored job/story gates, chapter award marker commits before player award. Guild/dispatch stage inventory copies before durable ledger commit and expose no intervening yield/callback. Existing native scripts, materials and rewards are preserved.

Ordinary scene entry/staging uses complete runtime guards; modal control locks and scene replacement retain original architecture. Encounter kills require owned serial/map/cursor, pending proofs retry their transaction, and scene/world resets release owned resources. No invented camera tracks introduced.

limitations: Source inspection and host sanitizer/GPU-recorded boundary execution; not native device execution
Natural progression/balance/controller/FATX and original 64 MB residency require target acceptance
Obsolete development/test save preservation is intentionally outside scope
